title: Warp numbered feature list
description: Typed tag, mono title and lead over a bordered two-column panel: on the left a stack of numbered rows (small grey number, geometric semibold title, muted mono line), on the right a tall product shot. A soft grey highlight steps down the rows one at a time, on a loop. Phones show the rows alone.
notes: the stepping highlight is CSS only (2 to 8 rows); with reduced motion the first row stays highlighted
the product shot is a media slot (hidden on phones, like the original)
